changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE users ( id UUID NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, user_role TEXT NOT NULL, first_name TEXT NOT NULL, last_name TEXT NOT NULL, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password TEXT NOT NULL, locale TEXT NOT NULL, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_on TIMESTAMP NOT NULL );

changeSet.author: Gustas Antanas Gaigalas 20222754
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE company ( id UUID NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, contact_email TEXT NOT NULL, contact_phone TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT NOT NULL, postal_code TEXT NOT NULL, country TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, created_on TIMESTAMP NOT NULL );

changeSet.author: Gustas Antanas Gaigalas 20222754
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE location ( id UUID NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, address TEXT NOT NULL, phone TEXT NOT NULL, domain TEXT NOT NULL, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_on TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES company(id), CONSTRAINT uq_location_company_name UNIQUE (company_id, name) );

changeSet.author: Gustas Antanas Gaigalas 20222754
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS company_id UUID;

changeSet.author: Gustas Antanas Gaigalas 20222754
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE inventory ( id UUID NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_on TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES company(id), location_id UUID REFERENCES location(id), CONSTRAINT uq_inventory_company_name UNIQUE (company_id, name), CONSTRAINT uq_inventory_company_code UNIQUE (company_id, code) );

changeSet.author: Gustas Antanas Gaigalas 20222754
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE item ( id UUID NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, sku TEXT, category TEXT, brand TEXT, manufacturer TEXT, model TEXT, part_number TEXT, serial_number TEXT, color TEXT, dimensions TEXT, weight TEXT, unit TEXT, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, description TEXT, notes TEXT, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_on TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, inventory_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory(id) );
